unknownBilling.label: Billing category unknown
unknownBilling.description: This run did not identify API or subscription billing. Any recorded charges are included in the inference ledger. For future runs, select an AI connection in the agent’s configuration so Paperclip can identify its billing.

missingModel.label: Model not reported
missingModel.description: Token usage was recorded without a model, so Paperclip cannot estimate its cost. Select an explicit model in the agent’s configuration for future runs. Changing settings will not reprice this past run.

missingPrice.label: Cost unavailable
missingPrice.description: The provider did not supply a reliable price for this usage. There is no action required for this past entry. New API runs with complete usage and a supported model are estimated automatically.

waitingForReceipt.label: Receiving usage
waitingForReceipt.description: This run has stopped. Paperclip is waiting for its final usage data and will record it automatically. You do not need to rerun the agent.

receiptUnavailable.label: Final usage unavailable
receiptUnavailable.description: This run stopped without final usage data. Its cost remains unresolved for budget checks. Paperclip will record a late receipt if one arrives; rerunning the agent will not recover this usage.

retryable.label: Ready to record
retryable.description: Saved usage data is ready to be recorded. Paperclip retries automatically, or you can retry now. This records costs only; it does not rerun the agent.

toast.noNewData: No new cost data is available.

recordingFailed: Cost recording failed. Try again shortly.
loadError: Cost details could not be loaded.
stale: Showing the last loaded cost details. Updates will resume automatically.
noGaps: No cost gaps remain in this period.
truncated: Showing the 25 most recent entries in each category. Select a shorter date range to inspect more.
